Chat request with response_format json_object that returns valid JSON content

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Respond with JSON only.\",\"role\":\"system\"},{\"content\":\"Give me a user object with name and age fields.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"response_format\":{\"type\":\"json_object\"}}")
    result = await client.chat(request)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
